name: Blessing of Aggramar refreshes Blade of Faith only at 10 Oath Chain stacks (#7806)
contract: Blessing of Aggramar 300502 Description[enUS]: 'Casting an Oath Breaker with 10 stacks of your Oath Chain now refreshes the duration of Blade of Faith on all nearby enemies.'

AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp OnSpellCast: Breaker(info) && player->HasAura(300502) && spell->GetScriptValue(704576) >= 10 refreshes every nearby (40 yd) Blade of Faith (803872) aura the player owns to its max duration; the stack count is captured at cast start. Righteous Upheaval 501562 has SpellFamilyName 25, FamilyFlags[2] 128, so Breaker(501562) is true.

No merged PR and no scenario cover #7806. A prior investigation comment reported 10 stacks refreshed the Blade and 9 did not, matching the tooltip; this scenario proves that already-working threshold with an independent expected value: the duration recorded right after Blade of Faith is first cast (its own max duration), not a number taken from the implementation.

steps.label: Both 803872 and 501562 require an active Oath Chain to cast
Blade of Faith on the target
SETUP: Blade of Faith is applied
Its own max duration, recorded right after it was applied
Oath Breaker finisher at 9 Oath Chain stacks
9 stacks does not refresh the Blade; it only keeps decaying
Oath Breaker finisher at 10 Oath Chain stacks
10 stacks refreshes the Blade past its pre-cast decayed value
10 stacks returns the Blade to (near) its own recorded max duration
